title: Coral Pink Hand Block Print Cotton Tunic Top for Women
color_custom: Coral pink with sage & white anar (pomegranate) block print
description:
Sunshine, the Jaipur way. This coral-pink cotton tunic is hand block printed with a lively anar (pomegranate) motif in sage and white – a symbol of abundance in Indian craft. Light, breathable and impossible not to smile in.

✦ The Details
• Mandarin band collar with a V placket and button front
• Soft pintucks at the front for a gentle flare
• 3/4 sleeves
• Hip length with a curved hem
• Easy pull-on style – no fuss

✦ Fabric & Craft
100% cotton – soft, breathable and perfect for warm days. Every motif is printed by hand with carved wooden blocks, so tiny variations are a mark of true handmade craft.

✦ Fit & Size
Regular, easy fit that skims the body. Choose your usual top size – size up for a relaxed, boxy look.

✦ How to Style It
Light blue flared jeans and clear heels for brunch; white straight trousers for office; denim shorts and kolhapuris for holidays; a white palazzo with silver jhumkas for a festive touch.

✦ The Bahe Promise
• Made in Jaipur – we send you photos of your piece before it ships
• Free custom fit on request – share your measurements
• Free worldwide shipping to the USA, UK, Canada, UAE & Australia, with tracking
• Real people on WhatsApp to help with size and styling

The colour may look slightly different on your screen.
care: Gentle hand wash in cold water separately for the first wash. Do not bleach. Dry in shade and iron on medium heat on the reverse side.
